The '''Nuffin freighter''' was a type of [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] manufactured by the [[Nuffin]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Nampi]] owned a Nuffin freighter and, around [[5 BBY/Legends|5 BBY]], used it to trap [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] aboard it. After her death, the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] took the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] to [[Cabrool Nuum]] on [[Smarteel]] and tried to sell it to him.
